D0_vanilla.technique: Textbook DeepONet: branch on (r, q, kappa, theta, xi, rho) plus a put flag, trunk on (S/K, v0, tau); price labels from the reference; Adam

D1_reduced.technique: Exact reduction: branch on (kappa, theta, xi, rho), trunk on (x, v, tau); put-call parity

D2_hard_payoff.technique: Black-Scholes at the expected average variance as the base: c = BS + tau <branch, trunk(x, v, sqrt(tau))>

D3_differential.technique: Differential (Sobolev) training: add the 10 derivative labels c_x, c_v, c_tau, c_kappa, c_theta, c_xi, c_rho, c_xx, c_xv, c_vv

D4_physics.technique: Physics-informed DeepONet: PDE residual on unlabelled collocation over the computational box (tau from 0, v to v_hi = 3 packed near 0, sqrt(v + 0.01) in the trunk), the degenerate equation on v = 0, c_v = 0 at v_hi and the far x boundary

D5_short_maturity.technique: Short maturities: 25% of the labelled contracts and of the collocation drawn with tau in 0.005 to 0.05

D6_lbfgs.technique: Quasi-Newton polish: full-batch L-BFGS warm-started from D5 on 4,096 labelled contracts and 4,096 collocation points

D7_scale_up.technique: Scale up: width and rank 128 and 131,072 labelled contracts from a fresh start, then the L-BFGS stage of D6

D8_envelope.technique: Enveloped correction as an implied-volatility output: c = BS(x, sqrt(w tau) e^N), whose first-order correction fades like the time value near expiry and away from the strike, with a drift split N = <branch(xi, rho), trunk_1> + (tau / tau_max) <branch(kappa, theta, xi, rho), trunk_2> so that kappa and theta drop out as tau -> 0 (the implied-volatility output without the split is reported as a variant); trained from a fresh start through the Adam and L-BFGS stages

D9_ensemble.technique: Ensemble: average of four independently seeded D8 trainings (seeds 0-3); Greeks are member averages
